data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to send app telemetry to New Relic Mobile
data.what_it_does: Collects crashes, network traffic, user sessions, logs, and traces from Flutter apps and forwards them to New Relic Mobile SDKs.
use_when: Want automatic error and network tracking
Require distributed tracing and interaction tracing
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, configure iOS SPM or CocoaPods, provide app tokens, call NewrelicMobile.instance.start
